basic_profile.bio: Avid Animal Crossing enthusiast and DIY collector from the Pacific Northwest. By day, I work as a structural engineer, solving complex problems and ensuring the safety of the buildings we inhabit. By night, I'm a gamer and part-time streamer, sharing my island adventures and tips with my followers. I love engaging with the Reddit community, especially in gaming and tech-related subreddits. I’m usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Proud parent of two cats and happily married to my high school sweetheart.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Civil Engineering and have been working in the structural engineering field for over a decade. My expertise includes designing resilient structures and understanding complex building codes. I've also completed a CCNA certification to better manage the tech aspects of my gaming and streaming setup.
